name: Browse product catalogue and submit an enquiry
description: Verifies the primary product browsing and customer enquiry journey.
steps: Browse products and filter a category
Add a product to the cart and request a WhatsApp quotation
expected: Products filter correctly, the cart contains the selected item, WhatsApp opens with order details, and the contact enquiry confirms receipt.

name: Explore the Electrical and Solar Knowledge Center
covers: knowledge center immediately below homepage hero
description: Checks that mobile visitors can search and read the new educational guides.
steps: Scroll below the homepage banner to the Electrical & Solar Knowledge Center
Search for LiFePO4 and open the matching battery guide
Choose Protection and open the MCB and SPD guide
Read the Urdu explanation and safety warning
expected: The knowledge center appears before the About section, search and category filters show relevant guides, topic details expand, and safety guidance is visible.

name: Use the solar and battery planning calculators
description: Verifies both calculators respond to changed numeric inputs and reject invalid values.
steps: Change battery capacity and average load in the backup estimator
Change daily energy and sun hours in the PV estimator
Enter zero for a required value
expected: Both estimates update from entered values, and zero or invalid inputs display a validation prompt rather than a misleading result.

name: Complete a service booking and track its status
description: Verifies the existing service booking flow remains available after the learning center update.
steps: Submit a complete service booking with a future date
Track the booking using its reference and phone number
Try submitting with a required field missing
expected: A booking reference is issued and can be tracked; incomplete input is rejected.

name: Keep reviews, gallery and administrator tools available
description: Checks the existing community and admin workflows remain reachable after the homepage enhancement.
steps: Submit a customer review and a project media item
Open the public review and project gallery
Open the administrator dashboard and review its learning content controls
expected: Submissions remain moderated, existing gallery and administrator controls remain reachable, and the page remains usable on mobile.
